description: This source file defines modules, functions, and classes related to rendering and configuring various types of charts (e.g., bar, line, band). It includes parsing mechanisms, space calculations, axis configuration, and drawing functions, indicating it is part of a chart rendering library or tool used within a larger project.

classes.name: u
classes.description: Axis configuration class managing range, tick calculations, and rendering elements for chart axes.

classes.name: x
classes.description: Subclass of 'u' representing a band (categorical) axis with specific scaling and tick methods.

classes.name: d
classes.description: Subclass of 'u' representing a linear numeric axis with tick generation and scaling.

classes.name: f
classes.description: Handles space calculation and drawable elements for chart components like the title.

classes.name: m
classes.description: Represents a plot element, such as a line, with methods to generate drawable paths.

classes.name: b
classes.description: Represents a bar plot element, calculating rectangles for chart bars.

classes.name: A
classes.description: Container for chart components including axes, plot data, and title, managing layout and rendering space.

classes.name: S
classes.description: Main chart layout class that calculates space allocations and manages drawing of chart components.

classes.name: C
classes.description: Static builder class for constructing chart drawable elements.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a chart layout ('S') and returns its drawable elements based on provided configuration.
